ESG Factbook

Sustainability>Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)

The ESG Factbook focuses on providing both quantitative and qualitative references and “Further Information” across the core dimensions of Volkswagen`s Environmental, Social, and Governance sections. In addition the Factbook also addresses broader ESG-relevant topics such as “Just Transition” and other emerging themes. It is primarily grounded in disclosures of the Annual Report 2025, with particular emphasis on the Sustainability Report 2025 as the core reference. To ensure a holistic and well-substantiated view, the Factbook also integrates insights from additional authoritative sources, including corporate policies, official websites, and other relevant governance documents.

#ESG

Factbook for Download

This page provides access to the current edition of the Volkswagen Group’s ESG Factbook as well as previous editions in the archive. These documents contain core ESG information and metrics. They provide a basis for evaluating the Volkswagen Group's ESG-related disclosures, data and performance indicators.


Disclaimer: The documents provided below are intended primarily for the information of investors, analysts, rating agencies and other capital market participants. They reflect the respective state of knowledge, planning and reporting as of the date of their publication. Actual circumstances, as well as the regulatory and legal framework, may have changed since publication. For current information and objectives, reference should be made to the most recently published documents and disclosures of the Volkswagen Group.

PAI Indicators

The Principal Adverse Impact (PAI) Indicators provide information on the significant adverse impacts of investment decisions on sustainability factors. They complement the Volkswagen Group’s ESG reporting and provide relevant information for investors seeking to incorporate ESG considerations into investment analysis and decision-making.

Principal Adverse Impact (PAI) Indicators 2025 (Excel) - 2026-04-27

Whitepaper

The whitepaper discusses approaches to defining and measuring sustainability-related revenues in the automotive sector. It shows how sustainable business activities in the automobile sector can be evaluated. The whitepaper thus offers additional insights into the importance of ESG criteria for sustainable investing.

Whitepaper - Measuring Sustainable Revenues in an Automotive OEM - 2026-04-29

Conference presentations - Archive (Download)

The presentations from the ESG Conference provide insights into the Volkswagen Group’s sustainability strategy as well as core ESG topics such as human rights and supply chain due diligence. They supplement the documents provided on this page—such as the ESG Factbook and the whitepaper—with additional information on ESG topics and sustainability-related activities of the Volkswagen Group.

The specified fuel consumption and emission data does not refer to a single vehicle and is not part of the offer but is only intended for comparison between different types of vehicles. Additional equipment and accessories (additional components, tyre formats, etc.) can alter relevant vehicle parameters such as weight, rolling resistance and aerodynamics, affecting the vehicle's fuel consumption, power consumption, CO₂ emissions and driving performance values in addition to weather and traffic conditions and individual driving behavior. Further information on official fuel consumption data and official specific CO₂ emissions for new passenger cars can be found in the "Guide to fuel economy, CO₂ emissions and power consumption for new passenger car models", which is available free of charge from all sales dealerships and from DAT Deutsche Automobil Treuhand GmbH, Hellmuth-Hirth-Str. 1, D-73760 Ostfildern, Germany and at www.dat.de/co2.
